why: This is a single institution's lesson-level workshop for a specific cohort of rising third-year medical students, with fixed vignettes, materials, staffing, and facilities, rather than a general reusable pattern.

This describes one study-specific small-group medical education session and its accompanying worksheet, facilitator guide, and surveys rather than a reusable instructional element or independently adopted product.
